title: Cost of computing NAND at the all-true input
statement: Let $Sign$ be the group of units of the integers, identified with the two signs $-1$ and $1$. Define NAND on two sign inputs to return $1$ exactly when both coordinates are $-1$, and to return $-1$ otherwise. Every zero-error randomized decision tree computing this function has expected query count exactly $2$ on the input whose two coordinates are both $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: The function is NAND on two sign inputs, returning $1$ exactly when both inputs are $-1$
The input has both coordinates equal to $-1$
$T$ is a zero-error randomized decision tree computing NAND
